methodologyNotes: Twelve log splitters spanning compact electric benchtop units through 35-ton tow-behind gas units and one professional commercial-grade splitter, re-verified 2026-08-01 against manufacturer product/spec pages and owner's manuals (WEN, Boss Industrial, Southland Power Equipment, Sun Joe, YARDMAX, Champion Power Equipment, DR Power Equipment, Swisher, Generac, Powerhorse/Northern Tool, Craftsman, Timberwolf) plus retailer corroboration (Lowe's, Home Depot, Ace Hardware, Farm & Fleet, Northern Tool, Amazon, Rakuten). Adversarial corrections made to the seed list: WEN 56207 corrected from an assumed '7-ton' to its actual manufacturer-stated 6.5-ton rating (model plate and manual both read 6.5 Tons). Champion '25-Ton 100251' (internal model 92500) is no longer in Champion's current lineup (verified via championpowerequipment.com/products/log-splitters/, which lists 15 current models and does not include 100251); replaced with Champion's current directly-comparable 27-Ton model 201312 (224cc, same engine family) sold at Northern Tool. 'DR PowerSplit' does not match any DR Power Equipment product name; corrected to the DR PRO 28T (model WH35028DMN), DR's actual current 28-ton gas splitter. 'Swisher LSRB875211' does not exist as a Swisher SKU; the digits match Swisher's real LSRB87528 (8.75 gross-torque, 28-ton), which shares an owner's manual with the LSRB67522 and is confirmed at current retail (Lowe's, Discounter Tools, ToolWorks Online) -- used as the intended product, with a note that Lowe's marketing copy states 344cc while Swisher's own spec table for this SKU states 190cc Briggs & Stratton (the manual figure is used as authoritative). 'Generac GS30' does not exist; Generac's GS series is pressure washers/generators, not log splitters. Generac's only current gas log splitter is the Generac Pro WH25034GMNG (34-ton, not 30-ton) -- used as the corrected product. 'Powerhorse 30-Ton' does not match any Powerhorse SKU; Northern Tool's Powerhorse gas lineup runs 22-ton and 35-ton (Item #1169) with no 30-ton model -- the 35-ton 1169 (420cc) is used as the nearest real product. Sun Joe LJ10M is NOT an electric motor unit despite the seed's implicit assumption -- Sun Joe's own listing title and manual confirm it is a manual (foot/hand-pump) hydraulic log splitter with no motor, so power_source, cycle_time_s (not applicable to a manual pump) and engine_cc are recorded accordingly rather than guessed. Two products were added beyond the seed list for tier coverage: Craftsman CMXGLXT2700 (27-ton, Kohler 196cc; a current, extremely common big-box gas splitter) and Timberwolf TW-5 (25-ton, Honda GX340 337cc; the segment's best-known professional/commercial-grade splitter, sold in 24/36/48 in. beam lengths with weight varying by configuration). Every priceUsd is a real current or recently-observed retail figure with its retailer cited; null means no verifiable price was found in accessible sources (common for commercial/dealer-network equipment like Timberwolf and for SKUs where Generac/Northern Tool/Zoro gate price behind login or JS-only rendering) -- never a guess. log_capacity_in is a descriptive string combining published max diameter and/or length since manufacturers report these as a pair, not a single scalar; several products only publish one of the two (diameter or length), and that gap is stated explicitly rather than inferred. wheels and weight_lb are null where no manufacturer figure was found. accessedAt 2026-08-01 throughout.
